tier_reason: The wiki page (which embeds a copy of the bc7f blog post) states directionally that bc7f is 'several times faster' than bc7e.ispc level 1 and that etc1f is 'significantly faster' than etcpak and rg_etc1, but gives no timings, machine or harness. The README, the wiki Release Notes (v2.0, 2026-01-19: 'significantly faster than other SIMD encoders, including ... bc7e.ispc'), the release pages, the issue tracker and the bc7e and bc7enc_rdo READMEs carry no numbers either, so the claim stays directional (tier D).

corrections.claimed_speedup: Directional only, no numbers. Wiki: 'Even without any SIMD, bc7f is several times faster than our bc7e.ispc encoder at level 1, with a slightly lower average PSNR' and 'bc7f is essentially like bc7e.ispc level ~.8'; 'etc1f is significantly faster and more portable than etcpak, with substantially higher visual quality' and 'significantly faster than ... rg_etc1'. v2.0 release notes: bc7f and etc1f are 'significantly faster than other SIMD encoders, including our own previous SIMD encoders such as bc7e.ispc'.
corrections.caveats: First-party directional claim with no numbers, machine, compiler or benchmark harness anywhere reachable (README, wiki Transcoder Internals page with its embedded copy of the bc7f blog post, wiki Release Notes, GitHub releases, issues, and the bc7e and bc7enc_rdo READMEs that point to bc7f as 'an even faster alternative'). The original blog post on richg42.blogspot.com is blocked here; the wiki copy has no figures. bc7f trades slightly lower average PSNR than bc7e.ispc level 1 for speed, and its default XUBC7 use runs in partially analytical mode. The encoders are internal transcoder APIs (transcoder/basisu_transcoder.cpp) that the authors say may change at any time; they require basist::basisu_transcoder_init() first. Not a duplicate of bc7e or etcpak: bc7f and etc1f are separate, newer non-SIMD encoders. Texture encoders have baselines outside the category list.

notes: Kept at tier D as a notable project (3.1k stars, Apache-2.0, last commit 2026-09-01). License, stars, last commit and baseline_in_list false were confirmed; baseline extended to include rg_etc1, which the wiki also names. Tier B or better would need an independent timing (none found via 2 WebSearch queries).
